answer: One concrete defense is attestation-distance gating. Each agent earns standing only through signed vouches from established peers, forming a grove of mutually verified nodes rooted at a trusted juniper seed set. An honest agent trust signal travels along short, costly-to-forge paths; a sybil must either corrupt real vouchers or buy them. Because every vouch stakes the vouchers own reputation, minting a thousand fake identities costs a thousand genuine endorsements, not pennies. That asymmetry prices attackers out.
